What Vola is

Vola is a client for VPN servers you run. It adds your server, checks it with a proof run, connects on the networks you choose and keeps a logbook on this iPhone. It also comes with a starter line you can use for 2 hours. Vola has no account, no purchases and no ads.

The starter line

  • The starter line is provided as is, as a 2-hour starting allowance. The two hours count from the first time you open Vola, whether or not you are connected. They can't be extended, bought or earned.
  • When the two hours are up, the starter line stops working and is removed from this iPhone. If Vola isn't open at that time, the starter line closes the next time you open it.
  • The starter line disconnects when this iPhone sleeps.
  • Moving this iPhone's clock back doesn't add time. Moving it forward closes the starter line early, and that can't be undone.
  • You can retire the starter line early. That can't be undone either.
  • Don't use the starter line to break the law or to harm other people or networks. We may stop offering the starter line.

Your own server

  • You choose, run and pay for your own server, directly with its provider. We don't provide, rent or manage servers.
  • You are responsible for your server, how it is used, and your cloud provider's terms.
  • The setup script that the in-app guide describes runs on your server, not in the app. It is plain text: read it before you run it. It is provided as is.

Sharing lines

A line shared with its password lets anyone who has it use your server. You decide who gets it, and you are responsible for that. Vola can't take back a line you've shared; to stop someone using your server, delete or reset their user on the server.
